description: This file defines the ControllerRequestArtifactInfo class, which models information about controller requests in the OFBiz framework. It manages associations between requests, views, and services, provides methods to populate related data, and implements identification and comparison mechanisms.

classes.name: ControllerRequestArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a controller request, including associated views, services, and related requests in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ControllerRequestArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with controller XML URL and request URI, and retrieves request info map.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates relationships such as service called, response views, and response requests after object creation.

methods.name: getControllerXmlUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the controller XML file.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a display name including request URI and relative location.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type of the artifact, 'Controller Request'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type ID for controller request artifacts.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Produces a unique identifier combining controller URL and request URI.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL location of the XML controller file.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on controller XML URL and request URI.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on string representation.

methods.name: getServiceCalledByRequestEvent
methods.description: Returns the service associated with the request event, if any.

methods.name: getFormInfosReferringToRequest
methods.description: Returns form widgets referring to this request.

methods.name: getFormInfosTargetingRequest
methods.description: Returns form widgets targeting this request.

methods.name: getScreenInfosReferringToRequest
methods.description: Returns screen widgets referring to this request.

methods.name: getRequestsThatAreResponsesToThisRequest
methods.description: Returns requests that are responses to this request.

methods.name: getRequestsThatThisRequestIsResponsTo
methods.description: Returns requests that this request is responding to.

methods.name: getViewsThatAreResponsesToThisRequest
methods.description: Returns views that are responses to this request.
